description: Tasks for StreamShield Azure Phase 1, with Fabric and Power BI deferred.

tasks.description: Capture current behavior of the in-scope Python backend before Azure migration.
tasks.requirements: Create a frozen behavior specification and mock/real decision table for external dependencies used by migration verification. Operate on a snapshot of backend/ only. Do not modify application code.
tasks.taskSummary: Failed before application analysis or baseline generation: the backend/ snapshot attempt hit Access Denied at backend/.pytest_cache/tmp. The resulting copy was incomplete and removed. Per task contract, stopped without using the live workspace. No frozen baseline artifacts were created.

tasks.description: Prepare and validate the Azure infrastructure design without provisioning.
tasks.requirements: Prepare and locally validate a deployable Bicep design for Azure Container Apps API and worker, PostgreSQL, Azure Managed Redis, private networking, monitoring, registry, and app configuration. Keep provisioning disabled in this planning task. Target the enabled Azure for Students subscription in East US 2; no resource group exists. The user authorized an isolated one-day trial despite unverified costs and accepts possible charges above US$50; do not claim a hard spending cap. Use an empty database; do not copy production data. Do not include secrets or connection strings. Fabric and Power BI integration are deferred.

tasks.description: Move the operational and dimensional PostgreSQL database to Azure.
tasks.requirements: Configure the in-scope Python backend to use Azure Database for PostgreSQL. The trial database starts empty and the application initializes its schema; do not copy production data or claim historical warehouse parity. Verify application behavior and analytics queries against the initialized schema. Use the supported Azure authentication method and document connection/security requirements. Do not migrate or enable BigQuery, Fabric, or Power BI embedding. Do not include credentials or resource IDs.

tasks.description: Move the StreamShield API and worker Redis connectivity to Azure Managed Redis.
tasks.requirements: Migrate Redis connectivity while preserving queue, cache, worker, and required TCP behavior. Use managed identity and TLS where supported; document private network access and failover. Do not provision Azure resources or include secrets or resource IDs.

tasks.description: Build integration tests for the migrated Azure services and verify application behavior.
tasks.requirements: Use mock mode while no Azure environment is available. Verify API/worker service boundaries, PostgreSQL and Redis behavior, health/readiness, and analytics queries against the PostgreSQL dimensional warehouse. Reuse the frozen behavior specification and external-dependency decision table from setupBaseline. Do not provision resources or store identifiers, connection strings, or secrets. Do not claim a live Azure verification.

tasks.description: Scan and remediate dependency vulnerabilities in the in-scope backend migration.
tasks.requirements: Scan dependencies for the Python backend and remediate applicable vulnerabilities with patched versions. Verify relevant builds and tests. Exclude backend-spring and unrelated security scope.

tasks.description: Deploy the Python API and worker to Azure Container Apps after technical readiness and cleanup gates pass.
tasks.requirements: Deploy an isolated Azure trial in the confirmed window, 25 November 2026 18:00 through 26 November 2026 18:00 UTC-05:00; the user confirmed to keep this start time rather than deploy immediately. Use an empty database; do not access or copy production data. The user explicitly accepted unverified costs and possible charges above US$50; do not claim a hard spending cap. Keep Vercel/Render production unchanged; configure only a Preview if authorized and available. Use East US 2. Before provisioning, complete and validate private networking, identity/authentication, immutable real API/worker images, secure app settings, health checks, and reliable deletion of only the dedicated trial resource group at the end. Run `what-if` before apply and stop on any failed readiness check. Fabric/Power BI remain deferred.
